tex_content.html:
Lemma
1. chA:A.37[LeeSM, Prop. 8.15] Let $M$ be a smooth manifold with or without boundary. A map $D : C^\infty (M) \to C^\infty (M)$ is a derivation if and only if it is of the form $Df = Xf$ for some $X \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$.

Given smooth vector fields $X, Y \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, define a map $[X, Y] : C^\infty (M) \to C^\infty (M)$ by \[ [X, Y]f = X(Yf) - Y(Xf). \]

A straightforward computation shows that $[X, Y]$ is a derivation of $C^\infty (M)$, and thus by Lemma A.37 it defines a smooth vector field, called the Lie bracket of $X$ and $Y$.
